sloka: आख्यास्यते प्रसुप्तस्य स्रस्तगात्रस्य भूतले ।सोच्छ्वासं हृदयं वीर कम्पमानं मुहुर्मुहुः ।। ६.१०२.१९ ।।
transliteration: ākhyāsyate prasuptasya srastagātrasya bhūtale ।socchvāsaṁ hṛdayaṁ vīra kampamānaṁ muhurmuhuḥ ।। 6.102.19 ।।

translations.english: 'Without Lakshmana who is difficult to win, what use is kingdom to me? What can I tell mother Sumithra who is the lover of her son?'
